name: TrueCount
tagline: Commit-reveal voting on Ethereum so no moderator can quietly change results.
problem: In student government, one moderator's judgment halved a candidate's votes, undermining trust.
solution: Voters commit private votes, reveal them later, and results stay permanently auditable on-chain.
demo_moment: Team-described: cast, reveal and audit a vote.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “ETHGlobal: Ethereum's Infinite Garden” among 261 submissions.
Started from a real election incident.

lessons: A concrete incident beats an abstract appeal to decentralization.
